visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, slightly messy hair stands centrally in a brightly lit subway station, looking directly into the camera with an expressive, questioning facial expression. He is wearing a white T-shirt layered under a black-and-white vertical striped collared shirt, and a large black leather tote bag is slung over his shoulder. The background features gray tiled walls and blurred figures of commuters walking past. (2) He reaches down into his black bag with a focused gaze and pulls out a sleek white tube of hand cream. He brings the tube close to the camera lens to show the label clearly, maintaining a friendly and engaging persona while commuters continue to pass behind him in the station's neutral-toned environment. (3) After showing the product, he squeezes a small amount onto his fingertips and begins rubbing his hands together. He then uses both hands to vigorously style and sculpt his hair, looking into the lens as if using it as a mirror. The overhead station lighting highlights the changing texture and volume of his hair as he applies the cream. (4) He completes the styling process and presents his new look with a confident smile and a wink towards the camera. He holds the white tube up next to his face to emphasize the product used. The video ends with him posing and moving his head slightly to show the hair's structure against the bustling subway background.

The background consists of a bright, major-key acoustic guitar progression and a steady, mid-tempo drum beat at approximately 115 BPM. Faint, muffled station room tone is present. (2) The vocal delivery remains energetic as he introduces a solution. A distinct, high-pitched 'ding' sound effect rings out as a digital UI-style emphasis. The acoustic music continues smoothly without any change in tempo or intensity. (3) The speaker provides a detailed explanation of using hand cream as a styling product, with his voice exhibiting high pitch variability and clear articulation. The BGM remains constant, providing a rhythmic backdrop to the rapid-fire speech. (4) The audio concludes with a final playful phrase in a mock French accent ('Bonjour'). The music reaches a natural cadence point and fades out quickly along with the ambient station murmur.
